_readme: Deadlines the season check cannot discover for itself: they are facts about
accounts only their owner can see. Each entry is {what, due, note}, with due
as YYYY-MM-DD or null for 'not filled in yet' — null makes the check nag
gently until the real date is put in. When one is dealt with, move its due
forward a year; the probe goes quiet on its own. The check warns from 60
days out and fails once the date has passed.

deadlines.note: The renewal date is on https://developer.apple.com/account under Membership details. A lapse removes the app from the App Store outright.

deadlines.what: Google Play target API level review
deadlines.note: Google ratchets the required target API level yearly, with deadlines usually at the end of August — https://developer.android.com/google/play/requirements/target-sdk says the current one. Falling behind first hides the app from new users on current Android. The fix is the annual maintenance release: bump targetSdkVersion, build, submit.

Not a renewal — a yearly reminder to confirm the keystore still exists in both places it should (repository secrets and the offline copy). It is the one unrecoverable secret; set due to a convenient annual date.
